question: Which of the following female athletes was awarded the 2025 Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year announced in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simone Biles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The legendary American gymnast **Simone Biles** was crowned the **Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year** in **April 2025**.
 
• This prestigious award was conferred upon her following her historic performance at the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**, where she reaffirmed her dominance in the world of **gymnastics**.
 
• During the **2024** season, **Simone Biles** captured **three gold medals** (Team, All-Around, and Vault) and **one silver medal** (Floor Exercise), becoming the most decorated American gymnast in Olympic history.
 
• The **Laureus World Sports Awards** are often referred to as the "Oscars of Sports," and winning this category signifies being the top female athlete across all sporting disciplines globally.
 
• This victory marks **Simone Biles'** **fourth** time winning the **Sportswoman of the Year** award, having previously won in **2017**, **2019**, and **2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• Established in **1999** by the **Laureus Sport for Good Foundation**, these awards celebrate the greatest sporting achievements of the year.
 
• The **2025** ceremony celebrated the achievements of athletes during the **2024** calendar year, with the event held in **April 2025**.
 
 
 
• **Simone Biles' Career Highlights:**
 
 
• Born in **1997** in **Columbus, Ohio**, **USA**, she has won a combined total of **41 Olympic and World Championship medals**.
 
• She is known for her extreme technical difficulty, with five skills named after her in the **Code of Points** across different apparatus.
 
• Her return to the **Paris 2024 Olympics** was highly celebrated as a successful comeback after she withdrew from several events at the **Tokyo 2020** games to focus on her **mental health**.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees for 2025:**
 
 
• **Katie Ledecky**: An elite **American swimmer** who continued her dominance in distance freestyle at the **Paris 2024** games.
 
• **Iga Świątek**: The **Polish tennis** star who held the **World No. 1** ranking and won the **French Open** in **2024**.
 
• **Athing Mu**: A prominent **American middle-distance runner** and **Olympic gold medalist** in the 800 meters.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:** The winners are chosen by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, a unique group of **71 sporting legends** who volunteer their time to support the foundation.
 
• **Impact Beyond Sports:** The **Laureus** organization supports over **160 programs** in more than **40 countries**, using the power of sport to end violence, discrimination, and disadvantage.
 
• **Historical Context:** **Simone Biles** joins an elite group of multiple-time winners, including **Serena Williams** and **Roger Federer**, who have been recognized by the academy for their long-term excellence and impact on their respective sports.
 
• **Record-Breaking Feats:** By **2024**, **Biles** became the oldest American woman to win an **Olympic gymnastics all-around title** since **1952**, aged **27**.
